query:
UPDATE jobs SET
               status = CASE WHEN $3::timestamptz IS NULL THEN 'dead'::job_status ELSE 'queued' END,
               run_at = coalesce($3, run_at),
               locked_until = NULL,
               last_error = $2,
               finished_at = CASE WHEN $3::timestamptz IS NULL THEN now() END
           WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'running'
